== Title ==
<span lang="ja">事態の悪化</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">どちらか選ぶこと。1 「もっとひどい目にあったかも」がプレイされた直後に使う。それをキャンセルし、さらにXフォース消費して 敵へのダメージをX増やす。2 敵が戦闘でフォースを失った後に使う。さらに1フォース失わせることができる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ルークは、惑星ヴォドラン原生のプラスチック捕食生物、ダイアノーガに襲われ、ついに最悪の事態を迎えた。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[It's Worse]].

'''Lore''' — Luke was attacked by a dianoga, a plastic predator native to the planet Vodran, and finally met the worst situation.

'''Game text''' — Choose one. Use immediately after It Could Be Worse is played; cancel it and use X Force to raise damage to the opponent by X. Use after the opponent loses Force in battle; you may cause them to lose 1 more Force.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore calls the dianoga a plastic predator, not a parasitic predator. Game text names もっとひどい目にあったかも and spends X Force to raise damage. White border.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-D-itsworse.gif|Original English face]], [[It's Worse]].</ref>
